name: class
description: Describes a Lua table type; this does not create a native Tua class.

name: field
description: Adds a typed field to the preceding annotation class. Repeating a callable field declares overloads, with each complete parameter list checked separately. For example, `---@field after fun(seconds: number, callback: fun())` and `---@field after fun(label: string, seconds: number, callback: fun())` describe two valid call forms. Ordinary field declarations keep their existing meaning.

name: param
description: Types a Lua function parameter. Native Tua annotations must agree with this contract.

name: type
description: Provides a type for a Lua declaration.

name: overload
description: Adds a known call signature for signature help and call checking.

name: deprecated
description: Marks an API deprecated; uses report TL4056 and editor surfaces show the guidance.

name: nodiscard
description: Reports TL4068 for a direct call statement that discards the resolved function result.

name: generic
description: Metadata only. Does not provide generic type inference or generic classes.

name: version
description: Metadata only. Does not select a runtime or change checking.

name: enum
description: Metadata only. Does not create a checked enum type.

name: meta
description: Identifies configured type_libraries declaration modules; does not execute or install a runtime library.

name: module
description: Metadata only. Does not import a module or resolve a runtime dependency.

name: diagnostic
description: Metadata only. Use Tua ignore directives to suppress Tua diagnostics.

name: cast
description: Metadata only. Does not narrow or cast the value in Tua.

name: as
description: Metadata only. Does not change expression inference in Tua.
